comment: Shared allowlist/suppression config for the public-release audits. Deep-merges over the defaults embedded in scripts/audit_common.py. Review this file whenever the audit surfaces new findings; never silence findings by deleting the config. Allowlisted values are fabricated test fixtures (fake addresses/phone/coordinates in tests and Massachusetts ingest fixtures), the GitHub noreply committer address used for synthetic PR merge-ref commits, and '2018 Constitutional Court' (a court name, not a street address; false positive of the street-address pattern).

allowlist.tax_ids_comment: Reviewed dispositions for PII-005, which flags any long numeric run, EIN-shaped or parcel-shaped value for human review. The 12-digit entries are manufacturer product identifiers on device records (UPC/EAN barcodes and article numbers), reviewed 2026-08-08 and confirmed to be published product codes. '12-3456789' is the sequential-digit documentation placeholder used as the worked example beside EIN_RE in scripts/ingest/validation.py and as the synthetic fixture in tests/test_validation.py and tests/test_massachusetts.py that proves the EIN detector fires; it is not an issued Employer Identification Number. Reviewed 2026-08-13. Add an entry only after confirming the number is a published product identifier or a documentation placeholder.
allowlist.addresses_comment: Reviewed false positives. 'Constitutional Court' matches the street-suffix pattern in legal citations such as 'the 2018 Constitutional Court ruling'; it is a court, not a street. The remaining entries are synthetic Massachusetts test-fixture addresses. Reviewed 2026-08-09. Add an entry only after confirming the match is not a real premises address.
allowlist.emails_comment: noreply@github.com and @users.noreply.github.com are GitHub-generated, non-personal addresses. beau@boorman.tech is the maintainer's own git committer identity, present in the author/committer field of every commit in this repository and already public in the GitHub commit log; it is not leaked third-party PII. Reviewed 2026-08-09.
allowlist.phones_comment: 555-01xx is the NANP block reserved for fictional use; such numbers cannot be assigned to a real subscriber and appear here only in test fixtures. 617-555-0199 is the specific fixture instance. Reviewed 2026-08-09.

suppressions_comment: Two classes, both self-detection. (1) Detector definitions: audit_sensitive_content.py and audit_common.py contain the PII regexes themselves, and test_sensitive_content_classification.py contains the synthetic PII-shaped fixtures that prove those regexes fire, including the negative controls that keep the business-contact rule from under-flagging. (2) PII-007 exclusion declarations: scripts/ingest/validation.py defines EXCLUDED_FIELD_NAMES, docs/audit-config.json defines prohibited_fields, data/massachusetts-ccc/privacy-spec.md and source-catalog.json are generated echoes of that denylist, the sync-reports directory records which fields the privacy gate BLOCKED on each run, and reports/jurisdiction-pipeline-audit.md describes the California schema fields the pipeline drops. Every one of these names a field in order to exclude it; none carries a value. PII-007 is a substring scan with no value allowlist, so a path entry is the only available disposition. The sync-reports entry ends in '/' because the directory gains a dated file per sync and an exact list would stop covering new ones. Reviewed 2026-08-13.
suppressions_history_comment: RESOLVED 2026-08-12. This key formerly recorded three LARGE-004 suppressions covering ~79 MiB of California DCC licensee data reachable in git history. docs/history-cleanup-plan.md was executed and main was force-pushed on 2026-08-12T18:04:56Z; the payloads are gone from origin/main and the suppression entries were removed. Verify with: git rev-list --objects origin/main | git cat-file --batch-check='%(objecttype) %(objectsize) %(rest)' | awk '$1=="blob" && $2>2000000' -- expect no output. A clone made before the rewrite still reports LARGE-003/LARGE-004 because those checks scan `git rev-list --all` over local refs; delete stale local branches and run `git gc --prune=now` rather than re-adding a suppression.
